baseline_models.focus_anchor: The matched causatives أَغْطَشَ and أَخْرَجَ govern the paired possessive phases لَيْلَهَا and ضُحَىٰهَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does more than name night and forenoon: it presents obscurity as a condition deliberately imposed and bright daytime as a condition brought from concealment into manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Intensifying night-darkness supplies the deliberately made obscure phase.
Night as the contrary of day supplies one pole of the temporal contrast.
Bringing a thing out of concealment makes the bright phase an achieved manifestation.
Forenoon radiance and clarity supply the visible state that is brought out.

changed_reading.before: The referent simply has a night and a forenoon.
changed_reading.after: Its alternating conditions are actively produced: darkness is intensified, while radiant daytime is brought into view.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَغْطَشَ can impair or evade sight, while أَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا moves toward public visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two clauses form a perceptual aperture: one narrows vision into obscurity and possible non-recognition, and the other opens the scene into exposed clarity.

activation_trace.role: Weak or veiled eyesight turns physical darkness into a constraint on perception.
Deliberate non-seeing keeps willful avoidance available beside involuntary visual weakness.
Extraction from hiding supplies the opening movement from latent to manifest.
Exposure to the sun supplies public appearance rather than light as an abstract quantity.

changed_reading.before: Night and forenoon are only astronomical periods.
changed_reading.after: They also organize a passage from occluded perception to an exposed field in which things can be recognized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of أَغْطَشَ includes a dark waste in which direction is lost, opposed by the outward exposure of ضُحَىٰهَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Darkening and bringing out daylight alter the usability of space: the same expanse can become trackless and inward-closing, then open, public, and traversable.

activation_trace.role: The unlocatable dark waste supplies a spatial loss of orientation.
Passage to the outside supplies reopening and movement beyond enclosure.
Solar exposure supplies the open, visible surface of the spatial field.

changed_reading.before: The clauses describe a change in illumination.
changed_reading.after: The change in illumination also changes whether the created expanse can be oriented within, crossed, and publicly seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening progression of removal, quick extraction, and management activates أَخْرَجَ as an ordered release: forenoon is not merely switched on but drawn out as one controlled operation in a larger sequence.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting a thing from its settled place supplies forceful removal from a prior state.
Peeling and extraction sharpen release as separation from an enclosing layer.
Managing with regard to outcomes turns the preceding motions into an ordered operation.
The focus verb's extraction from concealment receives the ordered-release pattern.
Radiant clarity is the state released by that operation.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 presents a chained progression from removal and motion to outstripping and management.
The focus likewise coordinates two transitive causatives rather than merely naming two times.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive extraction images and a final management image; I extend their operational pattern to the focus verb أَخْرَجَ. The live alternative is that the opening sequence concerns a separate event and contributes only rhetorical momentum.

changed_reading.before: Forenoon appears as a simple result of illumination.
changed_reading.after: Forenoon is released from concealment as a deliberately sequenced and managed cosmic operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A context branch explicitly includes the succession of stars, night, and day. It converts the focus's two parallel deeds into a governed handoff in which one made condition follows another.

activation_trace.role: The succession of stars, night, and day supplies the relational arrow between the focus's two phases.
Made night-darkness supplies the outgoing phase of the handoff.
Bringing from concealment supplies the transition into the following phase.
The extending forenoon supplies the incoming phase.

structural_cues: 79:7 predicates explicit following, while 79:29 uses matched perfect verbs joined by وَ.
The two focus objects carry the same feminine possessive suffix, reinforcing their membership in one system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a branch that names night-day succession and a verse of following; I infer that the focus's juxtaposed causatives participate in such a handoff. The alternative is that the two acts are coordinated without specifying cyclical order.

changed_reading.before: Darkening night and bringing out forenoon are two adjacent accomplishments.
changed_reading.after: They are interlocking phases of a stable succession, with obscurity yielding to an extending visible interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shown sign followed immediately by denial and disobedience splits visibility from reception. In the focus, bringing brightness into exposure makes recognition possible, while the self-blinding branch of أَغْطَشَ keeps refusal possible even after manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Showing and making visible supplies an explicit act of manifestation.
Denial after the shown sign demonstrates that exposure does not compel assent.
Departure from obedience turns failed reception into enacted resistance.
Willful non-seeing anchors the possibility of refusing what has become visible.
Extraction from hiding supplies objective manifestation.
Public solar exposure supplies the condition of available evidence.

structural_cues: 79:20-21 places showing, denial, and disobedience in immediate ف-sequence.
The focus itself opposes an obscuring causative to a causative of bringing into exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sign made visible and a subsequent refusal; I map that distinction onto the focus's visibility branches. The alternative is that 79:29 remains wholly physical and the narrative contributes no moral-perceptual layer.

changed_reading.before: Darkness blocks sight and daylight restores it.
changed_reading.after: Daylight supplies objective disclosure, but the paired obscuration image warns that subjective recognition can still be withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding construction chain resolves the feminine pronouns toward the sky and recasts night and forenoon as outputs of a built, raised, supported, and completed regulator rather than free-floating times.

activation_trace.role: The sky as what is elevated and overarches supplies the focus pronouns' contextual referent.
Building by joining parts supplies intentional construction rather than an unstructured expanse.
Raising supplies the vertical placement of the constructed system.
A roof that holds a building supplies a load-bearing canopy image.
Integrity and completion supply calibrated order within the canopy.
Darkening becomes one operation performed through the constructed sky.
Bringing out supplies the regulator's contrasting visible output.

structural_cues: 79:27-29 sustains feminine singular -ها from the sky through its height, equalization, night, and forenoon.
79:30 then explicitly shifts to the earth, placing the focus inside the sky-building unit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sky, construction vocabulary, and continuous feminine pronouns; I infer that temporal output is a function of this ordered sky-system. The live alternative is a looser antecedent such as the cosmic expanse, without the stronger regulator analogy.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified referent possesses night and forenoon.
changed_reading.after: The built sky is configured to produce contrasting temporal and perceptual conditions as part of its completed architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated causative أَخْرَجَ links brought-out forenoon to the later brought-out water and pasture. Daylight can therefore be read as the first visible yield in a sequence that makes the earth usable and provision-bearing.

activation_trace.role: Delivering water supplies a concrete extracted output that activates terrestrial productivity.
Pasture and grazing supply the living use made possible by the output sequence.
A useful provision for needs supplies the sequence's stated functional horizon.
The focus extraction verb provides the formal bridge to the later terrestrial extraction.
Exposed daytime supplies the environmental condition under which the provisioned surface becomes available.

structural_cues: 79:29 and 79:31 repeat the same causative أَخْرَجَ with feminine -ها objects.
79:31-33 moves from water and pasture to their benefit for humans and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated extraction verb, concrete outputs, and explicit benefit; I infer a functional arrow from daylight into the usable provisioning system. The alternative is that the two extractions are parallel gifts without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Bringing out forenoon is an isolated act of illumination.
changed_reading.after: Bringing out forenoon inaugurates a yield-pattern in which hidden resources emerge into a lit, usable ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembered action and an exposed object of sight extend the concealment-to-manifestation axis beyond the daily sky. The brought-out forenoon becomes a recurrent material rehearsal of a later disclosure in which what mattered can no longer remain hidden.

activation_trace.role: Restoring something to awareness supplies disclosure within memory.
Appearance and uncovering supply an eschatological counterpart to bringing brightness out.
Actual sight completes the movement from hidden condition to apprehended object.
Extraction from concealment anchors the recurring disclosure pattern in the focus.
Public exposure to daylight supplies the material rehearsal of final visibility.

structural_cues: 79:35-36 moves directly from recollection of action to the uncovering of what is seen.
The focus's second clause likewise moves an object from concealment into exposed clarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, uncovering, and sight; I treat daily emergence into light as an analogy for final disclosure. The alternative is that the creation and judgment scenes are evidentially related but do not share this specific disclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Forenoon is the recurrent visible half of the daily cycle.
changed_reading.after: Its recurrent emergence also models the surah's later logic that concealed deeds and destinations become present to awareness and sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final verse reuses ضُحَىٰهَا opposite an evening expression while denying long duration. This folds the focus's vast cosmic alternation into the small human measure by which an entire stay can seem no longer than one evening or its forenoon.

activation_trace.role: Remaining in a place supplies the duration whose apparent length is being compressed.
Evening time supplies the paired edge of the short remembered interval.
Night supplies the focus's dark temporal pole, echoed more narrowly by evening.
Extending forenoon supplies the exact phase recalled at the surah's close.

structural_cues: 79:46 exactly repeats ضُحَىٰهَا from the focus and pairs it with عَشِيَّةً.
The closing كَأَنَّهُمْ ... لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا construction explicitly converts cosmic time into perceived short duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact repeated form, an evening-forenoon pair, and minimized staying; I infer that the created cycle becomes a scale for collapsed human duration. The alternative is that 79:46 invokes only parts of one ordinary day without reflecting back on the creation pair.

changed_reading.before: Night and forenoon display the large, stable rhythm of the created sky.
changed_reading.after: That same rhythm becomes the closing unit that makes a seemingly immense human duration contract to part of a single cycle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because darkness is usually carried as deprivation, whereas the later garden and refuge cues make covering potentially protective. It remains anchored in the made night-darkness and in the context branches for night-covering and shelter, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain resonance, not as an equation of night with the Garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا makes darkness an actively produced covering rather than an uncaused absence.

activation_trace.role: Night's covering supplies a direct bridge between darkness and protective concealment.
Joining a sheltering destination supplies the protective function of enclosure.
Made night-darkness anchors the proposed covering in the focus wording.
Night and its darkness supply the actual temporal medium of concealment.

changed_reading.before: Darkening is solely the withdrawal of visibility.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory edge, made darkness can also function as a containing cover, before forenoon returns the field to exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus noun ordinarily marks forenoon, while its inventory also preserves gentleness and delay. The reading stays anchored in that branch and is activated by the Hour's fixed endpoint and warning sequence, but it should be qualified as a cadence of measured emergence or respite, not asserted as the lexical meaning of ضُحَىٰهَا here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ض ح و inventory attached to ضُحَىٰهَا includes a branch of gentleness and giving time, beside the ordinary forenoon branches.

activation_trace.role: Fixed anchoring supplies an appointed schedule that is stable even when undisclosed.
A terminal limit supplies the eventual end toward which the measured interval moves.
Warning that awakens caution supplies a purpose for the interval before the endpoint.
Gentleness and delay anchor measured, non-hasty emergence in the focus branch range.
Bringing into manifestation supplies the emergence whose pace is being explored.

changed_reading.before: Forenoon simply emerges as the bright counterpart to night.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, its emergence also carries a measured respite: clarity is brought out on an appointed course that leaves time for warning before the fixed end.

strongest_changes: The ر د ف branch turns the two focus clauses into a governed night-to-day handoff rather than isolated acts.
The sky-building chain resolves the feminine pronouns and makes night and forenoon operational outputs of a completed cosmic structure.
The repeated أَخْرَجَ links daylight with water and pasture as brought-out yields ordered toward use.
The exact return of ضُحَىٰهَا in 79:46 converts the large created cycle into a measure of radically compressed human duration.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation made one compact creation clause operate simultaneously as temporal regulation, perceptual disclosure, productive extraction, and the scale recalled at the surah's close, without requiring those readings to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The early extraction sequence may supply only rhetorical motion rather than a specific mechanism for daylight's release.
The repeated أَخْرَجَ securely creates parallelism, but a causal arrow from daylight to terrestrial provision remains reader-supplied.
The willful-blindness, protective-covering, and measured-respite branches are visibly anchored but should remain exploratory rather than control the ordinary temporal reading.
